lines.text: I took her shears. So why is she *smiling?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and breathless, no pauses, scared, the question shot out sharp.

lines.text: She didn't fight me. She stepped back, and every cable in the room began to *shake.*
lines.style: Young man, hushed and quick, rising fear, the last word sharp.

lines.text: I pressed my ear to one. Down below, a Theo was begging me to *cut* it.
lines.style: Young man, whisper, slow at first, then horrified and fast.
Young man, shaking whisper, confused and scared.

lines.text: You want out, Theo? Then let *go.*
lines.style: A little girl, soft sweet whisper, calm and creepy, smiling as she speaks, very slow.

lines.text: There's no button for Floor Zero. You only get there by *falling.*
lines.style: Young man, awed realisation, slow and quiet, the last word heavy.

lines.text: Cut my own cable... or cut them *all?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.
Young man, urgent and direct, straight to the viewer, short.

music.title: Floor 0 - Let Go
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a sharp metallic stinger, a vast dark attic drone, hundreds of steel cables thrashing and groaning, distant muffled screams through metal, a cold detuned music box for a little girl, a long falling whoosh down a deep shaft that opens into a warm eerie choir-free glow, then racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
